transcript.text: I need to flag a critical finding from my open-source review. I checked the dependency manifest and found that the toolkit links to a core library distributed only under AGPL-3.0. This means the release must be licensed under AGPL-3.0-only, and we must provide the corresponding source for the linked toolkit code. I've had this analysis in my release-gate working papers, but I want to make sure everyone is aware of this before we proceed. This is a significant licensing obligation that affects the entire release package.
